purpose: Define privacy, purpose, retention, disclosure, classification and other governance decisions as explicit evidence separate from AccessCore authorization decisions.

topics.name: Governance Decision Identity
topics.purpose: Define privacy, purpose, retention, disclosure, classification and other governance decisions as explicit evidence separate from AccessCore authorization decisions.

semantics.identity_rule: Each material governance decision has explicit identity.
semantics.policy_rule: Exact governance policy/profile revision is referenced.
semantics.result_rule: Allow/deny/partial/challenge/unknown semantics are explicit per decision type.
semantics.access_rule: Governance decision is orthogonal to AccessCore authorization; both may gate the same operation.
semantics.authority_rule: Decision applies only to exact scoped request/evidence context.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: governance allow reused as AccessCore allow

references.purpose: Governance and AccessCore decisions remain orthogonal.
